# ffxf_load_balancer (Resource)

Creates and manages a metered FFXF Cloud load balancer in a private network. Configure pools and listeners with their dedicated resources.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ffxf_load_balancer" "web" {
  name = "website"
  vpc  = ffxf_vpc.production.id
}

resource "ffxf_load_balancer_pool" "frontend" {
  load_balancer_id = ffxf_load_balancer.web.id
  name             = "frontend"
  protocol         = "http"
  algorithm        = "roundrobin"
  health_type      = "http"
  health_path      = "/health"

  targets = [
    {
      vm   = 150
      port = 3000
    },
  ]
}

resource "ffxf_load_balancer_listener" "https" {
  load_balancer_id = ffxf_load_balancer.web.id
  port             = 443
  protocol         = "https"
  default_pool     = ffxf_load_balancer_pool.frontend.id
  redirect_https   = true

  rules = [
    {
      hostname = "app.example.com"
      pool     = ffxf_load_balancer_pool.frontend.id
    },
  ]
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Load balancer name, up to 64 characters.
- `vpc` (Number) Private network ID whose machines may be targets.

### Read-Only

- `billing` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--billing))
- `certificates` (Attributes List) Managed HTTPS certificates and their current issuance status. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--certificates))
- `config_applied` (Boolean)
- `created_at` (String)
- `dns_name` (String)
- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.
- `ipv4` (String)
- `ipv6` (String)
- `last_error` (String)
- `last_seen_at` (String)
- `status` (String)
